PHD OPEN POSITION Cloud/Edge Computing & AI

PhD Position

Department of Computer Science • University of Innsbruck, Austria

| | | |---|---| | **Start Date** | Immediately | | **Duration** | 2-3 years |



Profile

We are looking for candidates with:

  • MSc or PhD degree programme in computer science

    • - Excellent knowledge of Cloud/Edge computing systems and/or AI
  • Excellent written and spoken English skills
  • Experience in software development
  • International project participation and leadership skills
  • Enthusiasm for university research
  • Flexibility and reliability
  • Communication skills in students supervision
    • - Ability to work in a team

    ---

    Working Environment

    **Founded in 1669** with several Nobel Prize winners, the **University of Innsbruck** is the largest educational institution in Western Austria ranked as an **international top-200 University in Computer Science**.

    With us, you can expect **exciting tasks**, **flexible working hours**, a **family-friendly working environment**, **attractive training and development opportunities**, a **paid lunch break**, a **meal allowance** and much more!

    The City of **Innsbruck**, which hosted the winter Olympic games twice, is located in the beautiful surroundings of the **Tyrolean Alps**. The combination of the Alpine environment and the urban life in this historically grown town provides a **high quality of living**.

    **Equal Opportunities & Diversity**

    > **The University of Innsbruck emphasizes equal opportunities and diversity in its personnel policy.**

    The University of Innsbruck strives to increase the percentage of women and thus expressly encourages women to apply. This is particularly true for leading positions and scientific job offers. In case of under-representation, women with the same qualifications will be given priority.

    Following Austrian disability legislation, qualified persons are strongly encouraged to apply.
